thread:
Maya R.: posted the postmortem for last night's multi-region outage (cloud provider capacity + model-registry auth spikes). we need to lock ownership and timelines for remediation items. cc @Rohan K., @Kevin T., @Anita P.
Rohan K.: saw it, thanks. rough plan: (1) short-term: cross-region fallback validation + canary failover test; (2) mid-term: capacity reservations and degraded-mode policy; (3) long-term: vendor SLA renegotiation.
Kevin T.: happy to own model-registry token rotation & auth caching changes. will need 2 weeks for rollout and a canary.
Anita P.: I'll take runbook updates and alerting tweaks (add explicit L2 runbook for auth-provider rate limiting). can do initial edits by EOD Wed.
Sara L.: recurring pattern note: we've had 3 auth-related incidents in 90 days with similar spike signatures. recommend a weekly regression watch for 6 weeks after fixes.
Maya R.: concrete action items: 1) Rohan - runbook for cross-region failover + scheduled dry-run (owner: Rohan K., ETA: 2026-04-02) 2) Kevin - model-registry auth token rotation + canary (owner: Kevin T., ETA: 2026-04-07) 3) Anita - runbook + pager thresholds (owner: Anita P., ETA: 2026-03-31) 4) InfraOncall Bot - add a recurring detection rule for auth spike fingerprints (owner: InfraOncall Bot / infra team, ETA: 2026-03-29) 5) Legal/Procurement - SLA review (tracker: procurement, owner: Sara L., ETA: 2026-04-15). pls ack and add any blockers. :clipboard:
Rohan K.: ack. I'll schedule a failover dry-run for 2026-04-01 09:00 PT and post invite. need infra support for temporary route swaps.
Kevin T.: ack. plan: deploy rotation job to staging, add short-lived cached tokens (30m -> 2h fallback), then canary in prod 10% traffic for 24h. will open PR and include perf metrics.
Anita P.: ack. runbook will include step-by-step rollbacks and a checklist for oncall. also adding play for model-registry auth fallback to use cached token path.
InfraOncall Bot: automated alert summary for incident 2462989999: 03/18/2026 22:10 UTC - auth error spike 5xxs -> downstream model-serving throttles; affected regions: us-west1, eu-central1. peak error rate 4x baseline. suggested rule: alert if auth 5xx rate > 3x baseline for 5m.
Sara L.: +1 to the detection rule. also suggest a weekly 'vendor incident retro' sync for the next 2 months to catch regressions.
OpsBot: Created ticket INF-8472: "Model-registry auth rotation & canary" assigned to Kevin T.; due 2026-04-07. Created ticket INF-8473: "Cross-region failover dry-run" assigned to Rohan K.; due 2026-04-01.
Maya R.: note on communications: external vendor escalation is in-progress, but please do not share internal runbook links externally. we'll update customers via status page template (I'll coordinate with comms).
Rohan K.: blocker: need permission to create temporary cloud routes in prod for the dry-run. @infra-team please confirm by 2026-03-26.
Kevin T.: small risk: token rotation might increase auth calls during warmup. I'll throttle rollout if we see auth TPS > 150%. will instrument and post metrics every 2 hours during canary.
Anita P.: suggestion: after canary, run a 7-day watch with daily summary in this thread. who wants to own the watch summaries?
Sara L.: I'll do the first two summaries, then hand off to platform ops.
Maya R.: sounds good. I'll own the customer-facing timeline and SLA follow-up.
Rohan K.: adding a short checklist for dry-run in case anyone wants to review: ```- notify oncall - 24h advance
- schedule traffic ramp (5% -> 50%)
- monitor latency, error rates, auth 5xxs
- fallback trigger conditions and rollback plan```
Kevin T.: will add telemetry dashboards: auth latency, token error rate, registry 5xx, model-serving latency.
InfraOncall Bot: Assigned INF-8474 to infra-team: "Add auth spike detection rule" due 2026-03-29.
Maya R.: thanks everyone. please drop short status updates in this thread only (and link tickets). we'll run a 2-week post-change review on 2026-04-21 to confirm the pattern is resolved or define next steps. :eyes:
